d:
The official music video for Staind's "It's Been Awhile," the breakthrough single from their 2001 album "Break the Cycle." The track became Staind's biggest hit in the post-grunge and alternative metal scene, reaching on the Billboard Hot 100 while topping both Modern Rock and Mainstream Rock charts. Aaron Lewis's vocals and Mike Mushok's guitar work defined the sound that kept "It's Been Awhile" on the charts for 20 consecutive weeks. The song established Staind as one of the most played rock bands of the early 2000s.
Lyrics:
And it's been awhile
Since I could hold my head up high
